observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: on an outdoor stage at night during a festival performance, with flags in the background and a seated audience
observation.formation_and_space: a single line holding hands across the front of the stage, sometimes curving or moving in circles and diagonals
observation.posture: upright or bent forward from the waist during group turns and synchronized forward bows
observation.footwork: stepping sideways, quick weight shifts, stamps and kicks while traveling in a line
observation.arms_and_hands: arms linked and held horizontally across adjacent dancers' backs or shoulders, with free arms gesturing or waving overhead
observation.hips_and_torso: torso bends forward and straightens synchronously with the steps and group movements
observation.levels_jumps_turns: low level bends/bows, occasional hop/skip, circular group turns
observation.costume_and_props: white long-sleeved shirts, dark trousers, red sashes around the waist, red headbands; bare feet
observation.cannot_infer: exact acoustic instrument breakdown beyond accordion and percussion due to audio mix quality; exact weight transfer nuances obscured by low video resolution

signature_moments.what: dancers in a line bow deeply forward from the waist together, then spring up and wave hands
the line circles tightly together while moving feet in rapid side steps and kicks
dancers travel sideways in a straight line while hopping and stepping rhythmically
